not_covered.text: The Israel Defense Forces claims that Sharif al-Hasanat, an alleged Hamas company commander affiliated with the Deir al-Balah Battalion of the Al-Qassam Brigades, was killed in an airstrike in Gaza, violating the ongoing ceasefire.
Five people are killed in a head-on road collision along the Lagos–Badagry Expressway near Lagos, Nigeria.
Seven people are killed and others are injured in a three-vehicle collision on the A66 road in Middlesbrough, North Yorkshire, England.
